faqs.q: Is BOBCARD Exclusive Credit Card for ICAI Members given to ICAI members only?
faqs.a: +- Yes, as the name suggests the BOBCARD Exclusive Credit Card for ICAI Members is given solely to ICAI members only. Applicants will have to submit a Photocopy of their ICAI Membership Card.

faqs.q: Can I get free add-on card against BOBCARD Exclusive Credit Card for ICAI Members?
faqs.a: +- Yes, you can get up to 3-lifetime free add-on credit card. The cards can be availed by primary credit cardholder for his/her immediate family members.

faqs.q: Can I use the reward points to pay off my credit card bills?
faqs.a: +- Yes, your reward points can be redeemed for cashback. You will get Re. 1 per 4 reward points.

faqs.q: How old the applicants for add-on cards should be?
faqs.a: +- The applicants for add-on credit cards must be over 18 years of age. They must also be directly related to the primary cardholder.
